description: Configure the global Apache web server settings to minimize information disclosure and disable the HTTP TRACE method. Specifically, set 'ServerTokens' to 'Prod' (or ProductOnly), set 'ServerSignature' to 'Off', and disable 'TraceEnable'. You should perform these changes through the Webmin/Virtualmin interface (under Apache Web Server > Global Configuration > Edit Config Files or specific modules) and ensure the changes are applied by restarting or reloading Apache.
